page_title: Preview3MF — 3MF Quick Look & Finder Thumbnails on macOS

summary.name: Preview3MF
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source macOS Quick Look extension that shows 3D previews and Finder thumbnails of .3mf 3D-printing files, in slicer filament colors for Bambu Studio and OrcaSlicer projects.
use_cases: Previewing 3MF print files in Finder without opening a slicer
Checking multi-color Bambu Studio or OrcaSlicer projects before printing
Inspecting model dimensions and triangle counts
Reviewing estimated print time and filament weight per plate
summary.what_it_does: Preview3MF adds a Quick Look app extension so pressing Space on a .3mf file in Finder opens an orbitable 3D preview of the model. It reads filament palettes and plate layouts from Bambu Studio and OrcaSlicer projects so multi-color models appear in their assigned colors, one plate at a time, and excludes boolean cutting tools. It also provides a thumbnail extension that reuses the slicer's embedded PNG preview or renders the mesh when none exists. The page lists dimensions, triangle and object counts, and, for sliced Bambu Studio and OrcaSlicer projects, estimated print time and filament weight per plate. It handles component assemblies and standard 3MF color groups.
notable: Quick Look app extension for macOS 13+, with Finder thumbnails for .3mf files
Reads Bambu Studio and OrcaSlicer filament palettes and plate layouts for accurate colors
Free and open source under the MIT License, signed and notarized, universal binary for Apple Silicon and Intel
caveats: Color painted onto part of a single mesh with the paint brush is not read yet; only per-object colors are
If Quick Look does not update, the user may need to run qlmanage -r in Terminal
